name: Aikount (Remote)
description: Hosted endpoint of the official Aikount MCP server (agent-first accounting for Spanish freelancers and SMEs), with the same tools as the aikount-mcp package: invoices, OCR expense ingestion, bank reconciliation, PGC ledger and trial balance, and Modelo 303 VAT returns. Authenticates with OAuth 2.1 (discovery and dynamic client registration).
